headline: Surveys Highlight Growing Divide Between Executives and Workers Over AI Rollouts
summary: Corporate surveys show chief executives report artificial intelligence implementation is progressing smoothly, while frontline employees express contrasting sentiment over how AI is changing their work.
why: Enterprises are spending heavily on AI integration, making workforce adaptation and sentiment critical to realizing operational productivity gains.

impacts.name: Enterprise Software
impacts.why: Employee friction can delay corporate AI deployment timelines and hamper anticipated productivity improvements.
